directions: Answer each question based on the text or data provided.

questions.stimulus: Bamboo grows so rapidly that a single culm can lengthen by almost a meter in 24 hours. This extraordinary rate has prompted architects to explore bamboo as a renewable building material.
questions.text: Which choice most effectively combines the two sentences?
options: Because it can grow almost a meter in 24 hours, architects are prompted by bamboo's extraordinarily rapid growth to explore it as a renewable building material.
Prompted by bamboo's ability to lengthen almost a meter in 24 hours, architects are exploring the rapidly growing plant as a renewable building material.
Bamboo grows rapidly, and architects are exploring it as a renewable building material because of this extraordinarily rapid growth rate of nearly a meter in 24 hours.
Growing as much as a meter in 24 hours, bamboo is extraordinary, this rate prompting architects to explore it as a renewable building material.

questions.stimulus: In an effort to ____ the impact of invasive lionfish on native reef species, Caribbean communities have organized annual spearfishing derbies.
questions.text: Which choice completes the sentence with the most logical and precise word?

questions.stimulus: Studies show that people are more likely to recycle when the bins are placed in convenient, high-traffic areas. Municipalities hoping to increase recycling rates should therefore ____.
questions.text: Which choice most logically completes the argument?
options: increase the price of trash collection services
require households to keep multiple recycling bins
position recycling receptacles where residents already congregate
fine residents who place recyclables in regular trash bins

questions.stimulus: The novelist grew up in a bilingual household, a background that profoundly shaped her narrative voice.
questions.text: Which choice best conveys the meaning of the sentence in a single, concise sentence?
options: Growing up in a household where two languages were spoken, the novelist's narrative voice was profoundly shaped.
Growing up bilingual profoundly shaped the novelist’s narrative voice.
Because the novelist grew up speaking two languages in her household, her narrative voice was profoundly shaped.
The narrative voice of the novelist was shaped profoundly because of her household that spoke two languages.

questions.stimulus: Data from a national survey indicate that 62 % of adults prefer text messages to phone calls for routine communication.
questions.text: Which interpretation of the data is most accurate?
options: Most adults surveyed favor texting over phone calls in everyday situations.
Nearly two-thirds of all adults never use phone calls.
Only 38 % of surveyed adults use text messages at all.
Adults universally communicate by text messages for every circumstance.

questions.stimulus: Helium is the only element that was first discovered in space rather than on Earth.
questions.text: Which revision of the underlined portion is most precise?

questions.stimulus: A recent analysis of rainfall patterns shows that extreme precipitation events have become ___ frequent over the past 50 years.
questions.text: Which choice completes the sentence?

questions.stimulus: Some historians argue that the Silk Road was not a single route but a complex network of intersecting trails.
questions.text: Which choice adds the most relevant supporting detail?
options: Spices and silk were popular goods.
These trails shifted as political borders changed.

questions.stimulus: Graph shows pizza sales by day: Mon 50, Tue 75, Wed 60, Thu 80, Fri 120.
questions.text: On which day were pizza sales 20 % higher than Wednesday?

questions.stimulus: Underlined: **their** in “Every fox returned to their den before dawn.”
questions.text: Which revision ensures pronoun-antecedent agreement?

questions.stimulus: Meteorologists use the term "atmospheric river" to describe a narrow band of concentrated water vapor that can deliver intense rainfall.
questions.text: Which choice most clearly defines “atmospheric river”?
options: a new phrase for any river that is in the sky
a narrow corridor of high-moisture air capable of producing heavy rain
clouds that look like rivers from satellite images

questions.stimulus: The committee reached a consensus quickly; the proposal, ___ had seemed controversial at first, was ultimately approved unanimously.
A study of 1 200 drivers found that those who listened to upbeat music tended to drive faster than those who listened to slower music.
questions.text: Which inference is best supported?
options: Music tempo may influence driving speed.
Slow music makes everyone drive poorly.
The study proves music causes accidents.

questions.stimulus: Researchers tested three fertilizers on tomato yield.
questions.text: Which fertilizer increased yield the most relative to no fertilizer?

questions.text: Which revision corrects the error?

Bird migration patterns have shifted northward by an average of 50 km over the past three decades.
questions.text: Which factor would most strengthen the claim that climate change caused this shift?
options: Many studied species rely on temperature-dependent food sources.
Some regions built more cell towers.

questions.stimulus: A museum curator wants to display artifacts chronologically but only has space for one-quarter of the collection. Which data display would best help decide which items to show?
Cheetahs accelerate faster than any other land mammal.
questions.text: Which revision adds the most relevant supporting evidence?
options: Their claws are non-retractable, providing traction.

questions.stimulus: “I have a dream that one day this nation will rise up,” King said, employing ____ to emphasize his vision.

questions.stimulus: The chart shows global smartphone users: 2015 = 2.6 B, 2020 = 3.8 B, 2025 (projected) = 4.7 B.
questions.text: Approximately what percent increase is projected from 2020 to 2025?

questions.stimulus: Some bacteria form endospores, allowing them to survive extreme heat, desiccation, and radiation.
questions.text: Which choice best explains how endospore formation benefits bacteria?
options: It enables dormancy under hostile conditions.

questions.text: Which is the most accurate conclusion?
options: Ad B performs significantly better than Ad A.

options: Blue wavelengths stimulate photosynthesis more effectively for plant X.
